subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as a first-class provider surface in the existing qwen plugin, or route it to an external/ClawHub provider instead?
rationale: The requested fix is technically bounded, but it adds new provider/auth/config surface and outbound hosts that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Accept in qwen plugin
options.body: Review and land the linked PR after conflicts and generated catalog/docs surfaces are resolved, making Token Plan an official qwen provider path.

options.title: Route externally
options.body: Ask for Token Plan support to ship as a separate external provider plugin through ClawHub if maintainers do not want another bundled Alibaba provider contract.

options.title: Reject the provider surface
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR if maintainers decide Token Plan support is not an OpenClaw-supported provider direction for now.

recommendation.title: Accept in qwen plugin
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR after conflicts and generated catalog/docs surfaces are resolved, making Token Plan an official qwen provider path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current qwen provider surface and has the clearest history on the owner boundary this feature would extend.
